candidates.explanation: The size check uses `<` instead of `>`. Files smaller than maxFileSize (5 MB) throw 413 'File too large', so a 200 KB png is rejected. Files at or above the limit, such as 20 MB, pass the check and get a signed URL.

fix.description: Reverse the comparison so the exception is thrown only when the file is larger than the limit: `file.fileSize > (maxFileSize || 0)`.
